CheckTitle: Supabase project restricts direct database connections to allowed IP ranges
Description: **Supabase projects** are assessed for **network restrictions** on the Postgres and connection pooler endpoints. By default any IP address on the internet may attempt to connect with valid credentials.
Risk: An unrestricted database endpoint turns every leaked connection string or weak password into a **direct path to all data** and lets attackers brute force credentials from anywhere, without passing through the application or its row level security.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Project Settings > Database > Network Restrictions
3. Click Add restriction and allow only the IPv4/IPv6 ranges of your backends, bastions and office egress
4. Remove 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 entries

Recommendation.Text: Allow only the CIDR ranges that must reach Postgres directly; route application traffic through the Data API or the pooler from known egress IPs.

Notes: Network restrictions require a paid plan; projects whose organization is not entitled to the feature are not reported.
